# Run Full Codebase Audit

## Purpose
Guide users through generating a full resolver-selected automation stack QA automation audit report.

## Recommended Workflow
1. Run `/audit-fullcodebase`.
2. Scan the full QA automation codebase and collect evidence.
3. Use `templates/audit-fullcodebase-report-template.md` for report structure.
4. Save final output in `reports/audits/full-codebase/`.

## Output
- One report file named `QAAuditReport_<YYYY-MM-DD>.md` in `reports/audits/full-codebase/`.
